context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 宅急便/鼻水/一戸建て/仮眠/鉄板/年越し/着地/日向

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、宅急便、絶対、お祖母ちゃんから、絶対、届いたよ
lines.en: Sho — a package from Granny just arrived. Really, I'm serious.
lines.style: Warm, present attention on Sho. Slight lift of genuine excitement. Speaking as much to include him in the moment as to inform. Natural, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鼻水、絶対、出てるよ
lines.en: Mom — my nose is running a little bit. I'm being serious.
lines.style: Earnest, unselfconscious statement. Direct eye contact. Small, matter-of-fact tone — not complaining, just reporting. A pause before the final assertion, like he's checking she hears him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いつか、本気で、絶対、一戸建て、絶対、引っ越したいわね、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, someday I'd really like us to move into a proper house.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost dreaming aloud. Softer attack. Slower pace. Speaking partly to Sho, partly to herself. A quiet yearning underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、仮眠、絶対、ソファで、絶対、取ってるよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom — Dad's napping on the couch right now. Seriously.
lines.style: Bright, conspiratorial observation. Quiet laugh underneath — affectionate commentary on Dad's habits. Quick, natural delivery. A small beat of amusement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今晩は、本気で、絶対、鉄板、絶対、お好み焼き、絶対、しましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: Tonight we'll make okonomiyaki on the griddle, yeah? Really looking forward to it, Sho.
lines.style: Warm invitation, slightly planning-aloud. Gentle enthusiasm — not overstated. The tone of someone who knows what will make him happy. Intimate, settling pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 年越し、本気で、絶対、家族みんなで、絶対、過ごしたいな、ママ
lines.en: I really want to spend New Year's Eve with the whole family, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine wish. Soft but clear. A pause held before 'Mom' — like he's thought about this. Small voice carrying something tender. No performance, just honest wanting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 飛行機の、本気で、絶対、着地、絶対、いつ見ても、絶対、ドキドキするわよね、翔くん
lines.en: You know, watching planes land — it never stops making my heart race, does it, Sho?
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly amazed. A gentle smile in the voice. Speaking as much to herself as to him. Wondering tone — the small thrill of something always new. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、日向、絶対、暖かくて、絶対、ぼく、絶対、好きだよ、ママ
lines.en: The sunny spot in the garden is so warm, and I really love it there, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Slow, warm delivery. The tone of someone sitting in that warmth right now. No urgency, just simple clarity about what brings him peace.
